issues.description: The function name 'normalize_header_name' follows the snake_case convention, which is consistent with the developer's naming convention.

The function has a nested try-except block. This can make the code harder to read and understand. It would be better to handle the exceptions in a single try-except block.
The function raises a RuntimeError with a generic error message. It would be better to provide a more specific error message that indicates what went wrong.
